intuition: Store each value together with the minimum up through that stack position.

brute_force.approach: Keep a normal stack and scan all values whenever getMin is called.
brute_force.time: O(n) for getMin; O(1) for other operations

optimal.approach: Keep a parallel minimum stack so every operation, including getMin, is constant time.

edge_cases: Duplicate minimum values remain minimum after one copy is popped.
The operation sequence may repeatedly push and pop values.
